headline: [Comeback Call?] Trump Says He Would Not Mind [Jensen Huang] Returning to Nvidia
sub: Nvidia board not considering it, AP reports
caption:
💻 Comeback Call? Trump Says He Would Not Mind Jensen Huang Returning to Nvidia

US President Donald Trump said on Monday, November 16, that he "would certainly not mind" if Jensen Huang returned as CEO of Nvidia. Huang resigned last week after reports of extramarital affairs. Trump said Huang had "learned a big lesson" and that he sees no national security risk.

🔹 Nvidia's chief financial officer, Colette Kress, is serving as interim CEO while the board looks for a replacement.
🔹 Some supporters are pushing for Huang's return, but a person familiar with the board's thinking told AP the board is not currently considering it.
🔹 Nvidia, the world's most valuable chipmaker, is due to report its quarterly earnings on Tuesday.

💬 Should Jensen Huang get his job back? 👇

Sources: AP, CNBC, NBC News

headline: [FIFA Battle!] UEFA Backs France's [Philippe Diallo] to Challenge Infantino
caption:
⚽ FIFA Battle! UEFA Backs France's Philippe Diallo to Challenge Infantino

UEFA, European football's governing body, has given its unanimous backing to French Football Federation president Philippe Diallo, 63, to run against Gianni Infantino for the FIFA presidency. Diallo has accepted, and his candidacy is due to be confirmed by the French federation on Tuesday.

🔹 The FIFA presidential election will take place at the FIFA Congress in Rabat, Morocco, on March 18, 2027.
🔹 Infantino, FIFA president since 2016, is seeking re-election and is backed by the Asian Football Confederation.
🔹 UEFA said it has "serious concerns over the direction of FIFA". Candidates must declare by Wednesday, November 18.

💬 Who should lead world football: Infantino or Diallo? 👇

Sources: AFP, Anadolu Agency, UEFA statement

photo_needed: Philippe Diallo (French Football Federation president), face clearly visible. If possible, a side-by-side with Gianni Infantino. Wide landscape photo.

headline: [Airspace Alert!] Japan Scrambles Fighters as Suspected [Russian Planes] Enter
caption:
✈️ Airspace Alert! Japan Scrambles Fighters as Suspected Russian Planes Enter

Two suspected Russian military aircraft entered Japanese airspace near Okinoshima, an island off Fukuoka in southwestern Japan, at about 4 a.m. local time on Tuesday, November 17. Japan sent fighter jets, which warned the planes by radio. Each plane stayed in Japanese airspace for about three minutes.

🔹 Japan said it is the first violation of its airspace by Russian aircraft since September 2024. Tokyo lodged a "very stern protest" with Russia.
🔹 Defence Minister Shinjiro Koizumi called it "a serious violation of our sovereignty" and "utterly unacceptable".
🔹 South Korea also sent fighter jets after Russian aircraft entered its air defence zone, but said its airspace was not violated. Leaders of Japan and Russia are both expected at the APEC summit in China this week.

💬 Why do you think this happened right before the APEC summit? 👇

Sources: AFP, Jiji Press, Japan Times
